\documentclass[paper={a5paper},maintitle={Adjacent Melody Test}]{ulsbs-songbook}
\begin{document}
\begin{songs}{}
\beginsong{Adjacent Melody}
  \newchords{adjacent}
  \memorize[adjacent]
  \mnbeginverse
    \[Am]\[<*>]adjacent chord and beat \[<C>]\[<*>]\[<D>]\[G]adjacent melody and beat annotations
  \mnendverse
  \replay[adjacent]
  \mnbeginverse
    \[<E>^]\[<*>^]\[<F>^]\[^]adjacent replay annotations
  \mnendverse
\endsong
\end{songs}
\makeatletter
\newdimen\ULtestpreviouschordwidth
\newdimen\ULtestexpectedwidth
\setbox\SB@chordbox\hbox{{\printchord{Am}}}
\ULtestpreviouschordwidth=\wd\SB@chordbox
\SB@firstchordfalse
\SB@setchord{\UL@melodyreplaypayload{*}{1}}
\ULtestexpectedwidth=\ULtestpreviouschordwidth
\advance\ULtestexpectedwidth by \UL@melodybeatwidth
\ifdim\wd\SB@chordbox=\ULtestexpectedwidth\else
  \errmessage{consecutive chord and beat annotations did not advance sequentially}
\fi
\sbox\UL@melodylayerbox{{\lyricfont\hspace{\ulChordWhitespaceMinimumWidth}}}
\ifdim\wd\UL@melodylayerbox>\UL@annotationcurrentwidth
  \ULtestexpectedwidth=\ULtestpreviouschordwidth
  \advance\ULtestexpectedwidth by \wd\UL@melodylayerbox
  \UL@annotationapplyminwidth
  \ifdim\wd\SB@chordbox=\ULtestexpectedwidth\else
    \errmessage{minimum width was not applied to the latter consecutive annotation}
  \fi
\fi
\setbox\SB@chordbox\box\voidb@x
\SB@firstchordtrue
\SB@setchord{\UL@melodyreplaypayload{*}{0}Am}
\setbox\UL@melodylayerbox\hbox{{\printchord{Am}\kern.2em}}
\ULtestexpectedwidth=\wd\UL@melodylayerbox
\ifdim\UL@melodybeatwidth>\ULtestexpectedwidth
  \ULtestexpectedwidth=\UL@melodybeatwidth
\fi
\ifdim\wd\SB@chordbox=\ULtestexpectedwidth\else
  \errmessage{beat and chord in one annotation did not overlay}
\fi
\makeatother
\end{document}
